items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions Kevin Mahagony as 'one of my good friends' and suggests he appear on the show; the interviewee (Marian McPartland) does not claim a personal relationship with him.

ctx.x: I think that would be fun.

Yeah, I think you’re right. It would be that unless, but, sometimes those shows also appear to be a little more driven, I think would be more influenced by either public perceptions and numbers, as well as media people saying, you should have Kevin Mahagony on here, because Warner Bros. has him signed to a recording. He’s one of my

good friends, so I can use him as an example. [laughs] He’s signed with Warner Bros. or a major record company. So the major record company folks are able to jockey people in through, especially if they happen to be on CBS, maybe, and CBS morning news program may, they have someone that can work those things there. That’s just my observation there as a third party. I may be totally off base.
